review_scope: Offline review of the sampled preview QA artifacts and the sample runner delta only; no emulation or shared QA artifact edits.

baseline_runner.role: Cold-boot and alignment runs; this is the baseline runner identified by the QA record.

sample_runner_delta_review.comparison: Unified diff of dispatch_preview_sampled_runner.py against headless_runner_fix6a.py; baseline and sample runner hashes above were independently recomputed.
additions: Builds a frame-to-name map from input-script ram_checkpoints.
At a requested frame, obtains libretro memory region 2 and copies it with ctypes.string_at, then writes that snapshot to a .ram.bin file in the run directory.
Adds the names of those RAM checkpoints to the result metadata.
negative_checks: The diff leaves the input event schedule, button mapping, frame loop, retro_run calls, state input/output, and handler code/operands unchanged.
The added memory access is a read-only retro_get_memory_data/retro_get_memory_size plus ctypes.string_at copy; no RAM write API, pointer assignment, or mutation of guest memory is added.
No code forces or synthesizes handler output variables; output values are sampled from guest RAM by the separate audit after the run.
sample_runner_delta_review.verdict: The sample runner delta adds observation checkpoints and host-side evidence files only. It does not force the preview handler outputs or write guest RAM. This is a static diff finding, not a claim that a runner is intrinsically side-effect free beyond the inspected code.

reviewed_runtime_record.integrity_summary: Audit report records SaveArray3 exact DSV match at both sampled captures, strict party record/cipher-boundary matching, and unchanged reserve-section fingerprints. Slot 2 of the No branch is mid-encryption and checksum-invalid at that instant; its exact native boundary match is recorded, so no decoded semantic claim is made for that record.

limits: No emulation was rerun during this independent review.
This is an isolated preview-only opcode probe: no EV/IV setter or reset, production item/menu integration, save/cold persistence after preview, or full-game acceptance is established.
The static runner-diff conclusion is scoped to the exact two runner files and hashes recorded above.
